title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Sarah Giles…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Sarah Giles Dynamic User Directory (dynamic-user-directory) affecting versions up to 2.4. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling an attacker to execute arbitrary scripts in a user's browser. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 score of 7.1, indicating high severity.
